rationale: The answer identifies CAPEC-182 as the related attack pattern and lists six consequence texts, but it attributes those consequences to CAPEC-248 rather than to CAPEC-182. It covers four of the six expected consequence strings, such as Integrity Modify Data and Confidentiality Read Data, while omitting extra terms in Confidentiality Other Information Leakage and Authorization Execute Unauthorized Commands Run Arbitrary Code. The main unsupported claim is that CAPEC-248 itself has the six consequences.
